messages:
morgan: Morning — quick async canary check. Canary v1.12 rolling at 5% in us-west-2. Plan: monitor 10m, then bump to 25% if healthy. TL;DR: progress, blockers, asks.

jess: Product here — feature flag is staged and only targets beta orgs, no schema changes. Holding off on wider rollout until infra gives 👍.

liam: SRE update — saw a p95 spike at 09:12 during the first minute after the roll (220ms -> ~480ms). Looking into autoscale and infra logs now. Not sure if this is transient.

anita: QA: running smoke and E2E. Found a failing streaming e2e for long-history chats (looks like stall/timeout). I'll paste repro in a sec.

morgan: Thanks. @anita can you paste a minimal repro? @liam I'm going to hold the bump to 25% until we confirm root cause.

anita: Repro steps: open chat with ~6 prior messages -> start streaming -> stream stalls after first chunk. Error in worker logs: ```ERROR: kv cache miss for convo 0x3f7a2b at 2026-03-17T09:10:59Z```

liam: Correlating — I see elevated KV cache eviction rate in canary pool around that time. Running `redis-cli info memory` showed ~80% usage and some churn. Could be eviction thrash causing stalls. @eng-infra FYI.

morgan: I'll roll a temporary config tweak to reduce memory pressure: lower batch_size 64 -> 48 for the canary cohort. Pushing a small PR (#4287) to infra/batcher. Can someone give a quick review? @anita please re-run that failing smoke after the config change goes in.

jess: Holding the flag bump until QA + SRE sign off. I'll update stakeholders after the 25% step. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12 batcher-config -> canary pool started at 2026-03-17T09:15:40Z. Change: batch_size=48. Status: in-progress.

liam: Post-change metrics look better — p95 back down to ~230ms over the last 120s, KV eviction rate dropped. Looks promising. Recommend keep at 5% for 30m and watch memory/eviction.

morgan: Agreed. We'll hold at 5% for 30m, then bump to 25% if stable. Blockers: need PR #4287 review and QA full-suite pass. Also follow-up item: investigate long-convo streaming path to avoid future kv-miss.

anita: Re-ran the earlier failing test after the config tweak — streaming passes now. Marking the repro as fixed and running the full suite (ETA ~20m).

jess: I'll prepare the release note snippet and stand by to notify marketing ops when we hit 25%.

liam: I'll create an alert: auto-fall back the flag if p95 > 400ms or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Putting that alert in now.

morgan: Thanks everyone. I'll post another update at 09:45 or sooner if anything changes.
